\paragraph{Summary of Observations.}
The tree is faster on \UnifiedWins{} of \UnifiedN{} inputs, with a median
tree/list ratio of \UnifiedMedian{}. Median ratios fall across the measured
size bands, and every source has a lower median at its largest measured
length than at its smallest. The tree's largest advantages occur on heavily
nested inputs with almost no splitting. Neither the selected split parameter
$k$ at a fixed length nor the two-sided split fraction shows a clear
relationship with the complete-sort ratio.
